name: Hofschank Waldlechn
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Hofschank Waldlechn in Ahrntal – Valle Aurina**

Nestled in the heart of **Tirol**, **Ahrntal – Valle Aurina** offers a serene escape into nature’s embrace. Here, at **Hofschank Waldlechn**, you’ll find a cozy retreat where tradition meets warmth.

Indulge in hearty **Tiroler** dishes like **Kaiserschmarrn**, creamy **Käsespätzle**, and tender **Schweinsbraten**, all crafted with local ingredients. Pair your meal with a glass of crisp **Südtiroler** wine or a frothy **Bier** from the region.

After your feast, take a stroll through the lush forests or explore the charming villages of **Ahrntal**. In winter, glide down the slopes of **Alpe di Siusi** or **Seceda**, just a short drive away. In summer, hike to breathtaking viewpoints like **Jaufenpass** or relax by the tranquil waters of **Lago di Carezza**.

At **Hofschank Waldlechn**, every season brings its own magic—whether it’s the crackling fireplace in autumn or the golden sunsets of summer. Come experience the authentic charm of **Tirol** in this hidden gem of **Ahrntal – Valle Aurina**.
